findings.claim: The new fixed-point StandardFormat('F') has no explicit precision, so decimal formatting uses the fixed-point default of two fractional digits. Consequently, serializing 123.456m produces a string rounded to 123.46, and deserialization returns a different value instead of preserving the decimal.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.DecimalFixedPointFormattingReceiptTests.DecimalSerializationPreservesFractionalValue in tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/Receipts/DecimalFixedPointFormattingReceiptTests.cs. It round-trips 123.456m through MessagePackSerializer and asserts equality; on head the rounded fixed-point representation fails the assertion.
